sourceFindings: Help load resets HelpClose to false.
With source rows, help allocates a new empty ColValue string array.
Enter on zero rows explicitly sets HelpClose true.
Escape closes the help form without setting HelpClose; the Closed handler only clears unrelated flags.
Sales caller returns unchanged on HelpClose true, otherwise a blank selected Design enters the Design-empty/image-N branch.
inference: The source path indicates ordinary Escape can clear the current Design/image through the empty-selection branch. It is not proof from running the original desktop executable.
webBehavior: Escape and Close deliberately retain the draft; exact source command parity remains an explicit acceptance gap.
supersedes: The broad cancellation-no-change assumption in the frozen round3 x11-design-to-order-next-contract; the frozen artifact remains unchanged.
